verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת עֲל֣וֹת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ וְהִ֨נֵּה־ לֶ֔קֶשׁ אַחַ֖ר גִּזֵּ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh hir·’a·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh yō·w·ṣêr gō·ḇay biṯ·ḥil·laṯ ‘ă·lō·wṯ hal·lā·qeš wə·hin·nêh- le·qeš ’a·ḥar giz·zê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD showed me . . . He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest as the late spring crop . . . was coming up
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR DEUS assim me fez ver, e eis que ele formava gafanhotos no princípio do rebento da erva serôdia, e eis que era a erva serôdia depois de findas as ceifas do rei.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־ כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽאֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ סְֽלַֽח־ נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- kil·lāh le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl ’eṯ- ‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh sə·laḥ- nā mî yā·qūm ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî qā·ṭōn hū
verses.literal: And when the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land I said Lord GOD please forgive How will Jacob survive since he is so small
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, tendo eles comido completamente a erva da terra, eu disse: Senhor DEUS, perdoa, rogo-te; quem levantará a Jacó? pois ele é pequeno.

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ni·ḥam Yah·weh ‘al- zōṯ lō ṯih·yeh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from this plan It will not happen He said
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR se arrependeu disso. Não acontecerá, disse o SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קֹרֵ֛א לָרִ֥ב בָּאֵ֖שׁ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ אֶת־ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אֶת־ הַחֵֽלֶק׃
verses.transliteration: kōh hir·’a·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh qō·rê lā·riḇ bā·’êš ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wat·tō·ḵal ’eṯ- tə·hō·wm rab·bāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leq
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD showed me . . . The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire It consumed the great deep and devoured the land
verses.literalPt: Assim me mostrou o Senhor DEUS: Eis que o Senhor DEUS clamava, para contender com fogo; este consumiu o grande abismo, e também uma parte da terra.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ חֲדַל־ נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ḥă·ḏal- nā mî yā·qūm ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî qā·ṭōn hū
verses.literal: Then I said Lord GOD please stop How will Jacob survive since he is so small
verses.literalPt: Então eu disse: Senhor DEUS, cessa, eu te peço; quem levantará Jacó? pois é pequeno.

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ זֹ֑את גַּם־ הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ni·ḥam Yah·weh ‘al- zōṯ gam- hî lō ṯih·yeh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the LORD relented from this plan It will not happen either said the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR se arrependeu disso. Nem isso acontecerá, disse o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔נִי וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ וּבְיָד֖וֹ אֲנָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh hir·’a·nî wə·hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ḥō·w·maṯ ’ă·nāḵ ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw ’ă·nāḵ
verses.literal: This is what He showed me Behold the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb with a plumb line in His hand
verses.literalPt: Mostrou-me também assim: e eis que o Senhor estava sobre um muro, levantado a prumo; e tinha um prumo na sua mão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָֽה־ אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲנָ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י הִנְנִ֨י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh ‘ā·mō·ws wā·’ō·mar ’ă·nāḵ way·yō·mer ’ă·ḏō·nāy hin·nî śām ’ă·nāḵ bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl lō- ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ ‘ă·ḇō·wr lōw
verses.literal: Amos what do you see asked the LORD . . . A plumb line I replied Behold said the Lord I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel I will no longer . . . spare them
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR me disse: Que vês tu, Amós? E eu disse: Um prumo. Então disse o Senhor: Eis que eu porei o prumo no meio do meu povo Israel; nunca mais passarei por ele.

verses.original: וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וּמִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְקַמְתִּ֛י עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·šam·mū bā·mō·wṯ yiś·ḥāq ū·miq·də·šê yiś·rā·’êl ye·ḥĕ·rā·ḇū wə·qam·tî ‘al- bêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: The high places of Isaac will be deserted and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword
verses.literalPt: Mas os altos de Isaque serão assolados, e destruídos os santuários de Israel; e levantar-me-ei com a espada contra a casa de Jeroboão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל אֶל־ יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ עָמ֗וֹס בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־ תוּכַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לְהָכִ֖יל אֶת־ כָּל־ דְּבָרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ă·maṣ·yāh kō·hên bêṯ- ’êl ’el- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr qā·šar ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘ā·mō·ws bə·qe·reḇ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lō- ṯū·ḵal hā·’ā·reṣ lə·hā·ḵîl ’eṯ- kāl- də·ḇā·rāw
verses.literal: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel saying Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel The land cannot . . . bear all his words
verses.literalPt: Então Amazias, o sacerdote de Betel, mandou dizer a Jeroboão, rei de Israel: Amós tem conspirado contra ti, no meio da casa de Israel; a terra não poderá sofrer todas as suas palavras.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר עָמ֔וֹס בַּחֶ֖רֶב יָמ֣וּת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar ‘ā·mō·ws ba·ḥe·reḇ yā·mūṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām wə·yiś·rā·’êl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: for this is what Amos has said Jeroboam will die by the sword and Israel will surely go into exile . . . away from their homeland
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz Amós: Jeroboão morrerá à espada, e Israel certamente será levado para fora da sua terra em cativeiro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָה֙ אֶל־ עָמ֔וֹס חֹזֶ֕ה לֵ֥ךְ בְּרַח־ לְךָ֖ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶאֱכָל־ שָׁ֣ם לֶ֔חֶם וְשָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·maṣ·yāh ’el- ‘ā·mō·ws ḥō·zeh lêḵ bə·raḥ- lə·ḵā ’el- ’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh we·’ĕ·ḵāl- šām le·ḥem wə·šām tin·nā·ḇê
verses.literal: And Amaziah said to Amos Go away you seer Flee to the land of Judah earn your bread . . . there and do your prophesying there
verses.literalPt: Depois Amazias disse a Amós: Vai-te, ó vidente, e foge para a terra de Judá, e ali come o pão, e ali profetiza;

verses.original: וּבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לְהִנָּבֵ֑א כִּ֤י מִקְדַּשׁ־ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ ה֔וּא וּבֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇêṯ- ’êl lō- ṯō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·hin·nā·ḇê kî miq·daš- me·leḵ hū ū·ḇêṯ mam·lā·ḵāh hū
verses.literal: But never prophesy at Bethel again . . . because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Mas em Betel daqui por diante não profetizes mais, porque é o santuário do rei e casa real.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן עָמוֹס֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ אֲמַצְיָ֔ה לֹא־ נָבִ֣יא אָנֹ֔כִי וְלֹ֥א בֶן־ נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי כִּֽי־ בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּבוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ‘ā·mō·ws way·yō·mer ’el- ’ă·maṣ·yāh lō- nā·ḇî ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·lō ḇen- nā·ḇî ’ā·nō·ḵî kî- ḇō·w·qêr ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·ḇō·w·lês šiq·mîm
verses.literal: I . . . was not a prophet Amos replied nor was I the son of a prophet rather I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Amós, dizendo a Amazias: Eu não sou profeta, nem filho de profeta, mas boiadeiro, e cultivador de sicômoros.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּחֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ יְהוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḥê·nî Yah·weh mê·’a·ḥă·rê haṣ·ṣōn way·yō·mer ’ê·lay Yah·weh lêḵ hin·nā·ḇê ’el- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me . . . Go prophesy to My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR me tirou de seguir o rebanho, e o SENHOR me disse: Vai, e profetiza ao meu povo Israel.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’at·tāh ’ō·mêr lō ṯin·nā·ḇê ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ṯaṭ·ṭîp̄ ‘al- bêṯ yiś·ḥāq
verses.literal: Now, therefore hear the word of the LORD You say Do not prophesy against Israel do not preach against the house of Isaac
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ouve a palavra do SENHOR: Tu dizes: Não profetizes contra Israel, nem fales contra a casa de Isaque.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֞ בָּעִ֤יר תִּזְנֶה֙ וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְאַדְמָתְךָ֖ בַּחֶ֣בֶל תְּחֻלָּ֑ק וְאַתָּ֗ה עַל־ אֲדָמָ֤ה טְמֵאָה֙ תָּמ֔וּת וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’iš·tə·ḵā bā·‘îr tiz·neh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·ḵā ba·ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū wə·’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ba·ḥe·ḇel tə·ḥul·lāq wə·’at·tāh ‘al- ’ă·ḏā·māh ṭə·mê·’āh tā·mūṯ wə·yiś·rā·’êl gā·lōh yiḡ·leh mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD says Your wife will become a prostitute in the city and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword Your land will be divided by a measuring line and you yourself will die on pagan soil And Israel will surely go into exile . . . away from their homeland
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR: Tua mulher se prostituirá na cidade, e teus filhos e tuas filhas cairão à espada, e a tua terra será repartida a cordel, e tu morrerás na terra imunda, e Israel certamente será levado cativo para fora da sua terra.
